security.withheld: This server does not lend its token for Dependabot, code scanning and secret scanning alerts, because every visitor would see them; each count links to GitHub instead. A private instance can set {flag}.
security.refused: "no access" means no token, a token without read permission for that alert type, or the feature is off for that repository.

token.title: 🔑 GitHub token
token.intro: GitHub answers 60 requests an hour to an address that sends no token. A full fork tree costs around 32, so the second visit runs dry. A token lifts the ceiling to 5000 an hour.
token.step1: Open Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, then Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: your own account. Expiration: any date, the tree needs nothing long lived.
token.step4: Leave every permission untouched. Public repository metadata needs none of them.
token.step5: Generate, then copy the {token} value. GitHub shows it exactly once.
token.classic: A classic token works as well: create one with no scope ticked at all. An empty scope still reads public data at the authenticated rate.
token.stays: It stays in this browser under the key {key} and travels only to {host}. It is never written into the address bar, so a link you share carries the view and not the credential. The button below the field erases it again together with the cache.
token.persistHow: Put the token into the {env} file of the server that hosts this page, beside {port}:
token.proxy: and start it with {make}. The container then writes an nginx snippet that attaches the {header} header to a {path} proxy, so the browser calls its own origin and never receives the token. This field disappears and every visitor shares the one budget of 5000 an hour.
fork.refused404: No branch lines: {message}. A 404 here is either a branch that does not exist or a path the server proxy does not carry; the fork network above is complete either way.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub is out of requests for this hour, so no branch lines could be drawn. The fork network above is complete. Add a token in the filter panel, or turn the branch lines off in the design panel to spend the budget on the network alone.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub answered {status} for the commit histories, so no branch lines could be drawn. The fork network above is complete.
fork.tagsOrphaned: A tag carries no date, so the rest would each cost a request that the hour's remaining quota is not spent on.
fork.axisZoomed: {axis}, the window of the loaded commits and tags. Fork lines older than it are clamped to the left edge.
fork.axisWhole: {axis}. Open a repository to draw its commit lanes and merges; the axis then narrows to that history.

A row is one test in one variant.

A row is one test in one variant.
